races.name: British EBF 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This looks a good opportunity for fairly useful bumper performer TURBOCHARGED to make a successful start over hurdles. Point bumper winner Lunar Trix appeals as one of more interesting Rules debutants, in race where the betting should offer plenty of clues.

  1. TURBOCHARGED (IRE)
  2. LUNAR TRIX (IRE)
  3. SHAH (FR)

races.name: Insurance Connections Best Bet Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SAFE DESTINATION was below form on his final 2 starts last season, but he returns with his yard going well so is worth another chance from only 2 lb above his last winning mark. Camarrate isn't taken lightly, though, following his encouraging chasing debut at this course, with last year's winner of this race Fern Hill also in the mix.

  1. SAFE DESTINATION
  2. CAMARRATE (IRE)
  3. FERN HILL (IRE)

races.name: 100 Punting Feats And Bad Beats 'Chasing Excellence' Mares' Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Preference is for FOLIE GOLITH, who has already run to a fairly useful level over fences with a pair of runner-up efforts in listed events in France. She can put that experience to good use to make a winning stable debut, with Siog Geal the pick for second as the highest rated of these over hurdles, ahead of Getawhisky.

  1. FOLIE GOLITH (FR)
  2. SIOG GEAL (IRE)
  3. GETAWHISKY

races.name: D&M Groundworks Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SEAMOON STORY is taken to pick up where he left off last season and make a successful handicap debut. The main danger could be Service Minimum, who has race fitness on her side and will likely benefit from a good pace to aim at.

  1. SEAMOON STORY (IRE)
  2. SERVICE MINIMUM (FR)
  3. STATIC (FR)

races.name: Thomas And Sonny Crilly Plant Hire Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
With all bar one of these making their seasonal return, it's difficult to know what to expect. The tentative nod goes to MISTER CESSNA, who won this corresponding race last year and arrives 4 lb below that mark having failed to fire since. Bobbi's Beauty ended last season with a comprehensive success at Taunton, so she gets the nod for the forecast spot over chasing debutant Rula Bula.

  1. MISTER CESSNA (FR)
  2. BOBBI'S BEAUTY (IRE)
  3. RULA BULA (IRE)

races.name: We Buy Cars On The Go Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
HOLEHEARTEDLY was brought along steadily by Dan Skelton last season and could be primed to make winning start in handicaps. Uhtred Ragnarson has been in good form over the summer and is feared most with Harry Cobden taking over.

  1. HOLEHEARTEDLY (IRE)
  2. UHTRED RAGNARSON (IRE)
  3. ADE BOY (IRE)

races.name: QuinnBet Mares' NH Flat Race (Conditionals/Amateurs) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MADAM SPEAKER sets a good standard for a race of this type and should prove hard to beat. Harzandacassandra finished behind the selection last time but retains some potential back in calmer waters, while Div Ine Glance is another with each-way claims if building on her debut promise.

  1. MADAM SPEAKER (IRE)
  2. HARZANDACASSANDRA
  3. DIV INE GLANCE

races.name: British Stallion Studs Future Stayers EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ARTHURIAN stands out on the form of his third in a C&D listed event last month and should get off the mark on return to testing conditions. If there's a fly in the ointment, it'll surely be Ralph Beckett's La Torre.

  1. ARTHURIAN
  2. LA TORRE
  3. TOP OF THE WORLD (IRE)

races.name: M6Toll Road To Victory Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
DESPERATE DAN and Empirestateofmind both make plenty of appeal given the likely conditions, with Peter Chapple-Hyam's class-dropping 5-y-o narrowly preferred. In-form Food For Thought merits plenty of respect for the Ralph Beckett yard, while On The River won this corresponding event in 2024 and should fare better back on turf.

  1. DESPERATE DAN (IRE)
  2. EMPIRESTATEOFMIND (IRE)
  3. FOOD FOR THOUGHT

races.name: M6Toll Road To Victory Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
VENETIAN LION still looks ahead of his mark and may enhance William Haggas' fine recent record in this race if coping with conditions. Mudlarks Thunder Roar and The Resdev Scholar are next best in an open-looking handicap, with Lir Speciale another to note on this sort of ground.

  1. VENETIAN LION
  2. THUNDER ROAR
  3. THE RESDEV SCHOLAR (IRE)

races.name: Vantage Consulting Powered By Requidex Nursery
races.verdict:
RESEMBLANCE still looks on a handy mark following a comfortable success at Ffos Las and she may well follow up. Pure Majesty is an interesting nursery debutant given her pedigree/connections, while Koodini makes each-way appeal in a race where several are unproven on the ground.

  1. RESEMBLANCE (IRE)
  2. PURE MAJESTY (IRE)
  3. KOODINI (IRE)

races.name: Jill Wilcox Jones Memorial EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ASHEYRA has been shaping up well in her 3 starts so far, finishing strongly when a close third at Newcastle on her latest outing, and she could be ready to get off the mark this time round. Faith In Florence arrives on the back of her best effort to date and is feared most, with Grateful Spirit one to note on debut.

  1. ASHEYRA (IRE)
  2. FAITH IN FLORENCE (IRE)
  3. GRATEFUL SPIRIT

races.name: Weatherbys Stallion Book Handicap
races.verdict:
CITY CAPTAIN has improved again this year, justifying good support as he doubled his tally for the season in game fashion at Hamilton 18 days ago. A 3 lb rise for that success looks fair and with underfoot conditions in his favour, another bold showing looks on the cards. Eye of Dubai has been revitalised by blinkers of late and he's a big danger, with 3-y-o Explosive Finnish another to consider.

  1. CITY CAPTAIN
  2. EYE OF DUBAI
  3. EXPLOSIVE FINNISH

races.name: Shape Engineering Handicap
races.verdict:
The drop back to 5f is possibly not ideal for IRISH NECTAR, but he won with such a degree of authority at Leicester on Tuesday that he could take some stopping under a penalty if getting the breaks. This is competitive however, with Duran, Harry's Halo, Charlie Mason and Woolisle just a handful of potential threats.

  1. IRISH NECTAR
  2. DURAN (IRE)
  3. HARRY'S HALO (IRE)

races.name: Get Daily Tips At racingtv.com Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
HIGH STORM got back on the up when scoring at Thirsk 6 weeks ago, seeing his race out well, and he is taken to follow up with this extra distance promising to suit. Yaa Min is much respected, though, following his commanding victory over this C&D last time, while Phantom Recon remains with potential as he goes handicapping.

  1. HIGH STORM
  2. YAA MIN
  3. PHANTOM RECON (IRE)

races.name: quinnbet.com Handicap
races.verdict:
A few with chances but FARABOVE THE LIMIT hasn't looked back since being gelded and gets a confident vote to complete a hat-trick having done well to overcome a steady pace when going in over C&D last time. Jujubella is next on the list in her bid for a fifth success here, while Mr Moonshine and Saxophonist can also play a prominent role.

  1. FARABOVE THE LIMIT (IRE)
  2. JUJUBELLA (IRE)
  3. MR MOONSHINE (IRE)

races.name: Northumbria Leisure For Gaming Machines Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
YAFAARR has thrived for the recent fitting of cheekpieces and is fancied to defy a 7 lb rise in the weights and notch a hat-trick at the chief expense of recent Wolverhampton scorer Variety Act. Guesstimate can also have a say on the back of a good Southwell second, while Porth Eilian and Patrol are others to consider in this competitive handicap.

  1. YAFAARR (IRE)
  2. VARIETY ACT (GER)
  3. GUESSTIMATE

races.name: QuinnBet Best Odds Guaranteed Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Brian Ellison holds a strong hand here and his consistent sort QILA is taken to gain a deserved first success at the chief expense of stablemate Sunday River who is much less exposed and rates a big threat. Ennoble and Nip About appeal as the pick of the rest for minor honours.

  1. QILA
  2. SUNDAY RIVER
  3. ENNOBLE (IRE)

races.name: Northumbria Leisure For Pool Tables Selling Stakes
races.verdict:
FIRST AMBITION has run in some competitive handicaps this season and stands out on paper dropping in grade. Kaleido looks the best option to chase him home.

  1. FIRST AMBITION
  2. KALEIDO
  3. CANDONOMORE (FR)

races.name: Margaret Macklam Memorial Handicap
races.verdict:
ROGUE ENCORE has done all his winning at this track and he's well treated if a break revitalises him, so he's worth chancing at the expense of Media Legend, who is the progressive runner in the field and last-time-out winners Coolree and Intrusively.

  1. ROGUE ENCORE
  2. MEDIA LEGEND (IRE)
  3. COOLREE (IRE)

races.name: Northumbria Leisure For Jukeboxes Handicap
races.verdict:
Course specialist PADDY'S DAY makes most appeal to open his account for the season from a reduced mark. The unexposed Leading Times can make his presence felt with Temple Of Athena another to consider dropping back in grade.

  1. PADDY'S DAY (IRE)
  2. LEADING TIMES
  3. TEMPLE OF ATHENA

races.name: Central Employment & Training Partnership Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
COULSTY EXCHANGE shaped much better than the bare result when sixth on handicap debut at this track a fortnight ago, making late headway under a hands-and-heels ride at 6f. The return to 7f should suit and she can make the breakthrough in a weak affair. Dream Forever has a solid course record and looks by far her biggest danger.

  1. COULSTY EXCHANGE (IRE)
  2. DREAM FOREVER (IRE)
  3. HEY HAVANA (IRE)

races.name: Central Employment & Training Partnership Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
LANARRA looks by far the most solid option here and can further enhance her course record against some limited rivals. Maynora may prove her biggest threat if turned out quickly.

  1. LANARRA (IRE)
  2. MAYNORA
  3. SPRINTING SPEED (IRE)

races.name: Quaff Box Handicap
races.verdict:
KEEP THE GOLD is yet to win but got back on track from a falling mark when runner-up over C&D last month and is unexposed on all-weather so this looks a good chance for him to get off the mark. Both Falcon Queen and Crypto Quest make appeal for the places.

  1. KEEP THE GOLD
  2. FALCON QUEEN (IRE)
  3. CRYPTO QUEST (IRE)

races.name: Join Racing TV Now British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
EXTRAGALACTIC wasn't able to build on his debut promise when second in a Musselburgh maiden last month, but the winner has scored again since and he's well worth another chance. Pushing The Limits made a promising first start and could be the main danger, with So Farhh completing the shortlist.

  1. EXTRAGALACTIC (IRE)
  2. PUSHING THE LIMITS
  3. SO FARHH

races.name: Join Racing TV Now British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
MY GIRL DEE MO took a sizeable step forward from her debut when going down by just a head at Haydock recently and with further improvement on the cards, Hugo Palmer's filly is expected to take some stopping. Heading up the threats is Pigeon Pete, who has found just one too good on both outings so far and he may have to settle for silver again. Lucky Test looks best of the rest.

  1. MY GIRL DEE MO (IRE)
  2. PIGEON PETE
  3. LUCKY TEST

races.name: Watch Live On Racing TV EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Preference is for TRAPPED GODDESS, who made a promising start to her career at Haydock last month and looks sure to build on that. Woollahra and From Afar are also likely improvers and look the obvious dangers.

  1. TRAPPED GODDESS (GER)
  2. WOOLLAHRA (IRE)
  3. FROM AFAR

races.name: Market Cross Jewellers Nursery
races.verdict:
It could be worth chancing LUNA LACY, who promises to be suited by this drop back in trip and looks fairly treated on her handicap debut. Cavan Lady and Lion of Persia rate the principal dangers.

  1. LUNA LACY (IRE)
  2. CAVAN LADY
  3. LION OF PERSIA (IRE)

races.name: Sam Hall Memorial Handicap
races.verdict:
An open-looking sprint in which a chance is taken on HANNEY GIRL, who found her run of good form halted in first-time cheekpieces last time, but Tim Easterby's filly can quickly get back on track with her usual tongue tie reapplied. Houndhill did well to get as close as he did when third over C&D last month so he can give the selection most to think about, with Sergeant Mayer and Tees Aggregates another couple worth mentioning, too.

  1. HANNEY GIRL
  2. HOUNDHILL
  3. SERGEANT MAYER (IRE)

races.name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
races.verdict:
INGLEBY ARCHIE is just below his last winning mark and got back on track when runner-up at Nottingham earlier this month. He makes most appeal. Mr Cool and Mayo County can also make their presence felt.

  1. INGLEBY ARCHIE (IRE)
  2. MR COOL (IRE)
  3. MAYO COUNTY

races.name: racingtv.com Handicap
races.verdict:
Cases can be made for any number of these but the most persuasive is for MOOSTAR, who finally broke her duck for this yard at Leicester 10 days ago and James Owen's filly escapes a penalty. Handily berthed in stall 2, she can get the better of Highfield Viking, who got off the mark for the year at Ayr recently and remains on a workable mark based on last year's form. Reginald Charles and Filey Beach are another couple with a squeak, as well.

  1. MOOSTAR
  2. HIGHFIELD VIKING
  3. REGINALD CHARLES

races.name: Watch Racing Replays At racingtv.com Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
SWEET KISS has benefited from the application of cheekpieces, narrowly denied over C&D in August and not seen to best effect in her last 2 races, so she could be ready to get back to winning ways. She gets the vote ahead of Pedro The Poet, who has been finding his feet for his current yard, while Electric Arc is one to note on handicap bow.

  1. SWEET KISS
  2. PEDRO THE POET (IRE)
  3. ELECTRIC ARC

races.name: Irishinjuredjockeys.com Apprentice Optional Claiming Race
races.verdict:
It could pay to concentrate on TYSON FURY and Plontier, who both have fairly useful form on the Flat this year, with Denis Hogan's charge preferred on his return to all-weather. Trishuli River is largely consistent on this surface and is the pick of the remainder.

  1. TYSON FURY
  2. PLONTIER (FR)
  3. TRISHULI RIVER (IRE)

races.name: Book Online At DundalkStadium.com Maiden
races.verdict:
Back on all-weather for stable debut, FIREWALKER showed much improved form when runner-up in a handicap here last month, beaten only by a thriving rival. He can build on that effort to go one better, at the chief expense of Palmeira who drops back in grade on first start for a new stable. Monmouth can also make his presence felt.

  1. FIREWALKER
  2. PALMEIRA
  3. MONMOUTH (IRE)

races.name: James Crowe 1 Year Memorial Nursery Handicap
races.verdict:
THIS THAT has taken his form up a notch the last twice, pulling clear with the odds-on favourite when getting off the mark at Navan, and he could do better still as he goes handicapping. He is preferred ahead of fellow nursery debutant Yellow Sky, while Two Brigade had excuses on his latest outing and rounds off the shortlist.

  1. THIS THAT
  2. YELLOW SKY (IRE)
  3. TWO BRIGADE (IRE)

races.name: Celebrate Your Special Occasion At Dundalk Stadium Handicap (0-60) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
Preference is for GO OUT, who performed well here earlier this year and has run creditably in higher-grade handicaps more recently. Dubai Opulence and Jazzy Dancer may provide the chief threat.

  1. GO OUT (FR)
  2. DUBAI OPULENCE (IRE)
  3. JAZZY DANCER (IRE)

races.name: Celebrate Your Special Occasion At Dundalk Stadium Handicap (0-60) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
BOSTON MAX has been holding his form notably well since registering back-to-back wins in the spring, so he appeals as a very solid option. Long-standing maiden Jazzit and Simmering Seas head up the opposition.

  1. BOSTON MAX (IRE)
  2. JAZZIT
  3. SIMMERING SEAS (IRE)

races.name: BAR 1 Betting 'Supporting Irish Racing' Handicap
races.verdict:
CITY HOUSE should get a good pace set up and can finally take advantage of his falling mark. Cool Azul appeals as the type to quickly bounce back and should be thereabouts, while Exquisite Acclaim can't be ignored on his effort here last week.

  1. CITY HOUSE (IRE)
  2. COOL AZUL (IRE)
  3. EXQUISITE ACCLAIM (IRE)

races.name: View Restaurant At Dundalk Stadium Handicap
races.verdict:
EASTERN PEACE has dropped to a handy mark and signalled she is ready to strike again when staying on into third over 9f at Punchestown last time so looks the way to go back over this longer trip. Enchanted Lady could emerge as the main danger now back on polytrack, although Limestone Red, Avec Grand Plaisir and Tribal Moon can all have a say too in this very open handicap.

  1. EASTERN PEACE (IRE)
  2. ENCHANTED LADY
  3. LIMESTONE RED (IRE)

races.name: Christmas Party Nights At Dundalk Book Now Handicap
races.verdict:
FINAL VOYAGE gets the vote on the back of his latest effort and is also eased in grade here. Quatre Bras goes well here and can give the selection most to think about, with Slieve Binnian one to consider with McMonagle in the saddle.

  1. FINAL VOYAGE (IRE)
  2. QUATRE BRAS (IRE)
  3. SLIEVE BINNIAN (IRE)
